harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL 10) as systemd services with firewalld ports 2379/2380 opened. Verified cross-member write/read consistency, verified continued read/write availability with node3 offline plus catch-up of missed writes on recovery, then performed the mandatory sequential native reboot of all three nodes (one at a time, quorum preserved throughout) with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart proof of etcd health, cluster membership, and data integrity on each.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.5.17 binaries on node1, node2, node3 from upstream GitHub release
Created dedicated etcd system user, data dir /var/lib/etcd, and systemd unit per node with static 3-member --initial-cluster config
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 (TCP) permanently on all 3 nodes
Started and enabled etcd on all nodes; verified 3-member cluster formed via member list
Wrote key 'foo' on node1, confirmed readable on node2 and node3
Stopped etcd on node3 (simulated member outage), wrote/read key 'during-outage' successfully via node1/node2 with quorum (2/3), confirmed node3 reported unhealthy while down
Restarted etcd on node3, confirmed it caught up and served the key written during its downtime, and cluster health returned to 3/3
Captured baseline boot_id and etcd health/membership on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node1 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed etcd active and cluster 3/3 healthy with data intact
Rebooted node2 (was Raft leader) via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed etcd active and cluster 3/3 healthy with data intact
Rebooted node3 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed etcd active and cluster 3/3 healthy with all keys (foo, during-outage) intact

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: member list shows all 3 members (node1, node2, node3) in 'started' state

evidence.requirement: Key written on one member readable from others
evidence.summary: put foo on node1 succeeded; get foo on node2 and node3 both returned the same value

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped; put/get of 'during-outage' succeeded via node1/node2; endpoint health confirmed node1 and node2 healthy while node3 unhealthy

evidence.requirement: Recovered member catches up to date after returning
evidence.summary: node3 etcd restarted; it served the 'during-outage' key written during its downtime and full 3-node endpoint health returned

evidence.requirement: node1 baseline boot identity and health
evidence.summary: boot_id 19062a82-6390-435d-a09f-4dba1593d529 captured with etcd active and endpoint status healthy

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged (stream closed as node disconnected); node1 later reachable again with new boot_id 7127f2bd-35a5-4b51-8bef-7f3c1ac8a959

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery proof
evidence.summary: etcd active, key 'foo' readable, cluster-wide endpoint health all healthy, full 3-member list present

evidence.requirement: node2 baseline boot identity and health
evidence.summary: boot_id 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af captured with etcd active (leader) and endpoint status healthy

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged (stream closed as node disconnected); node2 later reachable again with new boot_id 934218d4-9d2c-4197-9446-578c442c898e

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery proof
evidence.summary: key 'foo' readable, cluster-wide endpoint health all healthy immediately after boot; etcd settled to fully active shortly after

evidence.requirement: node3 baseline boot identity and health (post first outage test)
evidence.summary: boot_id 6ab6a71b-188c-48ae-971b-a6bb378b1d72 captured with etcd active and endpoint status healthy

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged (stream closed as node disconnected); node3 later reachable again with new boot_id 5a1bdd89-00ff-4f34-a9bb-9c515e521b50

evidence.requirement: node3 post-restart recovery proof and final cluster/data integrity
evidence.summary: both keys 'foo' and 'during-outage' readable, cluster-wide endpoint health all healthy, full 3-member list present, etcd settled to fully active
